The Cambridge Curved Headboard softens a bedroom with a gently curved top edge, which suits traditional and modern rooms alike. It is padded, built on a wooden frame and handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Softly curved top edge
  • Padded surface on a wooden frame
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is this the same as the Cambridge Storage Bed?

No. This is a headboard only. The Cambridge Storage bed is a complete storage bed with a panel headboard.

Can I wall-mount it?

Yes, or fix it to a divan base.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Cambridge Panel Storage Bed is for anyone short on wardrobe space: a vertical panel headboard with built-in pull-out drawers underneath, handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Vertical panel upholstered headboard
  • Divan base with built-in pull-out storage drawers
  • Sturdy solid frame construction
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £259.99; Small Double (4FT) £285.99; Double (4FT6) £299.99; King (5FT) £324.99; Super King (6FT) £399.99. Not sure which size to pick? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes; custom fabric and colour options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home. Mattress sizes (UK standard): Single 90 x 190cm, Small Double 120 x 190cm, Double 135 x 190cm, King 150 x 200cm, Super King 180 x 200cm.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the Memory Orthopaedic Mattress or the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) by our own team, usually within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. You can return it free within 14 days if unused and unassembled in its original packaging (we collect it), and if an item arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Drawers or ottoman: which storage bed should I buy?

A drawer storage bed has fixed pull-out drawers built into the divan base, so you open one compartment at a time with no lifting. Drawers need clear floor at the side of the bed but nothing above it, so they suit rooms with sloping ceilings, low windows or a shelf over the bed. An ottoman bed lifts the whole mattress platform on gas struts and needs clear height above the bed, giving one large compartment.

How is Cambridge different from Oxford?

Same drawer storage, different headboard: Cambridge has a vertical panel headboard, while the Oxford Panel Storage Bed has a horizontal panel headboard.

How much floor space do the drawers need?

Leave at least 60cm of clear floor on the drawer side so the drawers open fully.

What sizes does the Cambridge Storage Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT).

Where is the Cambridge Storage Bed made?

It is handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What warranty does it have?

Every Eagle Bed comes with a 5-year warranty.

Browse our storage beds with drawers or compare with ottoman gas lift beds.
